Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: I have lived ici for many seasons now, and even though you would think that the others would consider me as one of their own at this point ...

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: ... well, it is not like that, and I fear that this will never change.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: I will spare you les détails, but know that others still see me as sort of an « intruder » in their space.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: It is less bad now, but when I first arrived, there was no one to say hi to me. Strange Kweebecs are treated worse than les touristes.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: Even though I extensively negotiated my ... er, transfert from mon foyer d'origine with many benefits for Kweebdrasil, as is customs for the Kweebecois--

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: --Kweebecs, many of the locals think that I have come to take space from Kweebdrasil's seedlings. And seedlings of their seedlings. But you see how much room there still is on the tree, oui ?

Line.Text: So if you are not very lucky with vos voisins, I want you to know that you have a retraite ici. And anyone else like us.

Choices.Text: Why are there so many flags, anyway?
